scope: Primary theorem statements and applicability only; bounded search does not clear historical priority.

sources.title: On rank-one convex functions that are homogeneous of degree one
sources.locator: Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2, PDF page 2; arXiv v1
sources.inspected_claim: Positive one-homogeneity plus rank-one convexity yields convexity at matrices of rank at most one.
sources.applicability: J_r has degree four. The candidate fourth-root reduction fails explicitly for J_1 at I in direction e11.

sources.title: Automatic quasiconvexity of homogeneous isotropic rank-one convex integrands
sources.inspected_claim: Nonnegative, positively p-homogeneous, isotropic rank-one-convex integrands with p at least n are polyconvex at conformal matrices.
sources.applicability: Isotropy requires both independent rotation actions. J_r fails right rotational invariance for every positive r.

sources.title: Quasiconvexity for the Dacorogna-Marcellini Energy
sources.inspected_claim: Rank-one convexity and quasiconvexity coincide for homogeneous quartics invariant under both left and right SO(2) rotations.
sources.applicability: J_r is only left invariant and is outside the displayed theorem hypotheses.
